reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering minerals, fireworks, fish dishes, fish, a musical block, and fossils were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover mineral facts, safety wording, established food and fish terms, fossil anatomy, item number and gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

FireOpal_Description.source: A rare variety of opal, named for its red spots.
FireOpal_Description.translation: O varietate rară de opal, numită astfel datorită petelor sale roșii.

FireQuartz_Description.source: A glowing red crystal commonly found near hot lava.
FireQuartz_Description.translation: Un cristal roșu strălucitor, întâlnit adesea lângă lava fierbinte.

FireworksGreen_Description.source: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
FireworksGreen_Description.translation: O tradiție veche pentru sărbători și festivități. Manevrează-le cu grijă!

FireworksPurple_Description.source: An old tradition for celebrations and festivities. Handle with care!
FireworksPurple_Description.translation: O tradiție veche pentru sărbători și festivități. Manevrează-le cu grijă!

FishStew_Description.source: It smells a lot like the sea. Tastes better, though.
FishStew_Description.translation: Miroase foarte tare a mare. Gustul este totuși mai bun.

Flounder_Description.source: It lives on the bottom, so both eyes are on top of its head.
Flounder_Description.translation: Trăiește pe fundul apei, așa că ambii ochi se află în partea de sus a capului.

Fluorapatite_Description.source: Small amounts are found in human teeth.
Fluorapatite_Description.translation: Cantități mici se găsesc în dinții oamenilor.

FluteBlock_Description.source: Plays a flute sound when you walk past.
FluteBlock_Description.translation: Redă un sunet de flaut când treci pe lângă el.

FossilizedLeg_Description.source: A thick and sturdy leg bone.
FossilizedLeg_Description.translation: Un os de picior gros și rezistent.

FossilizedRibs_Description.source: Long ago, these ribs protected the body of a large animal.
FossilizedRibs_Description.translation: Cu mult timp în urmă, aceste coaste protejau corpul unui animal mare.
